0.001.descriptor: Radius span among sampled starts within the stated absolute training log-MSE gap; not a confidence interval.

regularized.interpretation: Mean of eight unweighted vertex-sphere fits per outer corner cap. Describes this model, not a common local principal radius or a model-independent structural measurement.
regularized.selection: One local augmented fit initialized from the three-start primary training winner. Fixed inherited lambda0.1; all parameters fit on training only.
regularized.limitation: Full-cohort extension followed an eight-case validation diagnostic after primary test scores had been examined; exploratory, not a fresh confirmatory test.

config.seed: New five-plane 8400-candidate rounded-family winner, selected on original even radial bands only.
config.preflight_revision: Independent near-sphere synthetic target exposed local minima for4/12/22nm starts;18/24.5nm controls added before any measured-data optimization.
config.start_selection: Minimum training log-MSE; validation/test never select starts.
config.split: Even 10-pixel radial bands train; odd 1 mod4 validation; odd 3 mod4 test, full detector for evaluation.
config.objective: Mean squared log1p ADU residual on sampled training pixels; free nonnegative signal/background.
config.primary_shape: Isotropically scaled, rounded cube plus fixed clipped-octahedral core. Radius is a common Euclidean corner/edge radius before faceting.
config.radius_definition: Physical r_nm = radius_base_nm*exp(log_scale); normalized rounding = radius_base_nm/26.
config.primary_regularization: No angular/aspect shape modes in the primary interpretable-radius family; no radius penalty.
config.natural_radius_limit: 0 <= base radius <= 26 nm at sphere limit; optimization capped at25.5 to retain nondegenerate face patches and fixed core containment.
config.profile_description: Reoptimize scale, three local rotation angles and signal/background at fixed radius on training only; descriptors, not calibrated confidence intervals.

data_domain.source: CXIDB57 existing209-pattern cohort and five-plane bank
data_domain.detector_ADU: Existing nonnegative-clipped ADU data, log1p least squares; no calibrated photon-noise likelihood.

numerical_qa.selection: Smallest measured cost among configurations passing independent forward and finite-difference gates; no measured-data held-out scores used.

synthetic_recovery.target: Noise-free independent continuous boundary integral on finer arc24/core-subdivision3 meshes; fitted family arc12/core-subdivision2.
synthetic_recovery.selection: Minimum training objective across all starts; no held-out selection.

physical_controls.scope: Predetermined cases; exact references freeze fitted parameters, finer-model refits use original sampled training pixels only.

0.0.caveat: The augmented model has varying local curvature; nominal r*scale is a shape-family coordinate, not a common Euclidean radius.

0.1.caveat: The augmented model has varying local curvature; nominal r*scale is a shape-family coordinate, not a common Euclidean radius.

uncertainty: Reported quantiles describe fitted radii across different patterns; they are not confidence intervals for one common radius.
Three-start local fitting is not a proof of global optimality. Profiles and additional starts probe only predetermined cases.
Unknown ADU noise, density/background/illumination mismatch and fixed core-shell assumptions can bias physical interpretation.
A single Euclidean radius is defined only for the primary isotropic rounded family. Added shape freedoms have a nominal family coordinate and varying local curvatures.
Validation/test bands were not used to choose initializations, radius bounds or the synthetic/numerical settings. These are within-pattern exploratory holdouts, not a new independent experiment.

The primary isotropic model worsened test loss. Added shape freedoms and inherited regularization were extended after validation diagnostics, with primary test scores already visible; this is exploratory.
The regularized radius is a cap-sphere descriptor. Frequent aspect bounds, residual non-sphericity, initialization and structural assumptions limit its physical interpretation.
